title: RBI Penalty on Infinity Fincorp Solutions Private Limited - KYC and Fair Practice Code Violations
description: <cite index="16-1,16-2">RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹5.40 lakh on Infinity Fincorp Solutions Private Limited for non-compliance with certain provisions of the 'Reserve Bank of India (Know Your Customer (KYC)) Directions' and the directions issued by RBI on 'Fair Practice Code'.</cite>
